summary: Ten games were played on Wednesday, and road teams won seven of them. Boston and San Antonio both came back from 22 points down to win, and Brooklyn's 145-111 win at New Orleans was the night's largest margin at 34 points. Franz Wagner scored a night-high 38 in Orlando's 123-108 win at Utah.

games.headline: Nets score 145 in rout of Pelicans
games.story: Brooklyn went ahead for good at 7-5 in the first quarter, scored 39 in the opening period and led 83-66 at halftime. An 11-0 run spanning halftime pushed the lead to 91-66, and it peaked at 41 points at 133-92 midway through the fourth. Michael Porter Jr. and Egor Dëmin each scored 22 with four threes, and Day'Ron Sharpe had 15 points, five assists and four blocks on 5-of-6 shooting. Zion Williamson scored 29 for New Orleans, which was without Trey Murphy III and Bennedict Mathurin.

games.headline: Celtics erase 22-point deficit, edge Raptors 98-93
games.story: Toronto scored 38 in the first quarter and led 59-37 midway through the second before Boston answered with 16 straight points. The Raptors still led 93-90 with 1:14 left, but the Celtics scored the last eight points and went ahead for good on a free throw with 25 seconds to go. Jayson Tatum had 24 points, seven rebounds and eight assists, Derrick White added 19 points and four blocks, and Neemias Queta grabbed 13 rebounds. Ja'Kobe Walter led Toronto with 17 points, and the Raptors were without Kawhi Leonard and Scottie Barnes while Boston played without Paul George.

videos.title: Final 5:09 WILD ENDING Celtics at Raptors | November 11, 2026

games.headline: Harden scores 32 as Cavaliers win at the Garden
games.story: Cleveland led by 12 late in the first quarter, and New York used an 11-0 run in the third to tie it at 69. The Knicks tied it again at 101 in the fourth before the Cavaliers went ahead for good at 104-101 with 4:22 left and closed it out at the line. James Harden scored 32 on 9-of-14 shooting with five threes, Donovan Mitchell added 23 points, seven rebounds and six assists, and Jarrett Allen had 14 rebounds. Jalen Brunson scored 27 for the Knicks, Karl-Anthony Towns had 21 points, 11 rebounds and eight assists, and Miles McBride hit five threes.

videos.title: Final 6:13 Cavaliers at Knicks Ending UNCUT | November 11, 2026

games.headline: Nuggets hold off Grizzlies 123-118 in Memphis
games.story: Denver never trailed, scoring 35 in the first quarter and leading 42-24 early in the second. Memphis scored 38 in the third and got within one point at 87-86, then pulled to 120-118 with 20 seconds left before the Nuggets made their free throws. Jamal Murray scored 30 on 12-of-19 shooting, Nikola Jokić had 27 points, 11 rebounds and eight assists, and Cameron Johnson added 23. Ty Jerome and Jaylen Wells each scored 22 for the Grizzlies, and Cedric Coward and Cameron Boozer had double-doubles.

games.headline: Rockets never trail in 115-108 win over Warriors
games.story: Houston scored the game's first basket, led 35-20 after one quarter and never trailed, though Golden State tied it three times, the last at 49-49 late in the second. The Rockets led 85-79 after three and stretched it to 111-93 with 3:32 left before the Warriors closed with a late run. Alperen Sengun had 19 points, 13 rebounds and nine assists, Amen Thompson scored 19 on 8-of-11 shooting, Kevin Durant added 20 and Fred VanVleet had 18 with three steals. Yaxel Lendeborg led Golden State with 25 points and 10 rebounds, and the Warriors were without Jimmy Butler III and Kristaps Porzingis.

games.headline: Dončić scores 32 as Lakers beat Bucks 123-112
games.story: Los Angeles went ahead for good at 8-7 in the first quarter on a 12-0 run and led 61-50 at halftime. The Lakers scored 33 in the third to lead 94-73 and pushed the margin to 24 at 114-90 before Milwaukee closed with 39 fourth-quarter points, including a 13-0 run late. Luka Dončić scored 32 with five threes, Sandro Mamukelashvili added 23 with five threes, and Austin Reaves had 18 points and three steals. Tyler Herro scored 27 with seven assists and Jaime Jaquez Jr. had 25 for the Bucks, who were without Myles Turner.

games.headline: Avdija scores 28 as Trail Blazers top Thunder
games.story: The lead changed hands 11 times, with Oklahoma City up by nine in the first quarter and Portland ahead by 12 early in the third. The Thunder went in front 92-88 early in the fourth, but the Trail Blazers went ahead for good at 100-99 with 3:56 left and won the quarter 30-23. Deni Avdija had 28 points, six assists and four steals, Jrue Holiday scored 19 with five threes and Sidy Cissoko added 19. Shai Gilgeous-Alexander scored 31 for Oklahoma City, which was without Chet Holmgren and Jalen Williams, and Portland played without Shaedon Sharpe and Ja Morant.

games.headline: Franz Wagner scores 38 as Magic pull away in Utah
games.story: The lead changed hands 19 times and the score was tied 16 times, and Utah led 87-85 after three quarters. Orlando broke a 98-98 tie with eight straight points, going ahead for good with 6:30 left, and won the fourth 38-21. Franz Wagner scored 38 on 13-of-23 shooting with eight rebounds, Desmond Bane added 25 with seven threes, and Anthony Black had 22 points, seven rebounds and eight assists. Darryn Peterson led the Jazz with 22 points, and the Magic were without Paolo Banchero and Jalen Suggs.

videos.title: Franz Wagner Drops 38 To Tie His CAREER-HIGH In SLC🔥 | November 11, 2026

games.headline: Wembanyama scores 32 as Spurs rally past Bulls
games.story: Chicago scored 41 in the first quarter and led 64-42 midway through the second. San Antonio cut into it with two 11-0 runs around halftime, the second giving it a 74-73 lead in the third, and went ahead for good at 83-82 late in the quarter. Victor Wembanyama scored 32 on 13-of-18 shooting with nine rebounds and five blocks, Dylan Harper had 18 points, 10 assists and four steals, and De'Aaron Fox added 17 points and nine assists. Jalen Smith scored 23 on 8-of-9 shooting with five threes for the Bulls.

videos.title: Wemby Powers Spurs To 10th Straight Win With 32 PTS, 5 BLK At Chicago 🔥 | November 11, 2026
Victor Wembanyama leads Spurs with 32 points in comeback win

games.headline: Pacers pull away from Wizards with 15-0 run
games.story: The lead changed hands 12 times, Washington led by eight in the second quarter, and the game was tied 77-77 after three. Indiana scored 15 straight points spanning the third and fourth quarters to turn a 77-76 deficit into a 91-77 lead and won the fourth 37-24. Pascal Siakam had 28 points, eight rebounds and five assists, Ivica Zubac added 20 points and 12 rebounds, and Andrew Nembhard had 17 points and 10 assists. Kyshawn George scored 25 for Washington and Anthony Davis had 21 points and 13 rebounds, while the Pacers were without Tyrese Haliburton.
